node.statement: For the arbitrary data of node 1 under 0 <= eta <= rho_2, the identity Delta_n X Delta_n Y-tilde-Delta_n X tilde-Delta_n Y=(Delta_n-tilde-Delta_n)X Delta_n Y+tilde-Delta_n X (Delta_n-tilde-Delta_n)Y, the C*-norm product inequality, C_V*eta <= 1/4, and the bounds supplied in the preceding admissibility/import steps give ||Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y)-Phi_n(tilde-Delta_n X tilde-Delta_n Y)|| <= (2+C_V*eta)*C_Delta*eta*||X||*||Y|| <= 3*C_Delta*eta*||X||*||Y||.
